SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
AscentApp
Entry point for the Ascent fitness workout planner.
CardioExercise
A cardio exercise measured by distance covered over a duration, such as running, cycling, or swimming.
ConsoleUI
Menu-driven console interface for the Ascent fitness workout planner.
DateUtil
Small helper for checking that a date string is a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
Exercise
Base class for a single logged exercise.
FlexibilityExercise
A flexibility or mobility exercise, such as stretching or yoga, measured by duration and perceived intensity rather than weight or distance.
Goal
A simple calorie target, checked against a WorkoutLog's logged history to see how close the user is to reaching it.
StrengthExercise
A weight-training exercise: a number of sets, each with a number of reps lifted at a given weight.
Workout
A named training session made up of one or more exercises performed on the same date, such as "Push Day" or "Leg Day".
WorkoutLog
The full training history: every workout a user has logged, in the order they were added.
